name: US equity stress
summary: VIX eased to 26.8 by 26 Nov, below the 27 exit line; S&P 500 8.1% below its 52-week high
state: The VIX stood near 26.8 in the latest reading on 26 Nov, down from a peak near 35.9 on 20 Nov and below the 27 level needed to leave the Alert band, though still about 56% higher on the month (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 last closed near 7,183 on 25 Nov, 8.1% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and inside the 5–15% Watch band, with a worst day of -3.7% in five sessions. No circuit breaker has tripped.
for_you: Market swings have calmed from last week's peak, but share prices remain well below their highs; pensions and savings linked to US equities stay exposed to further volatility.
rubric_hit: VIX 26.8 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 8.14% ≥ 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
